endorsements.quote: Human oversight must remain explicit, with the treating clinician responsible for diagnosis, interpretation and recall recommendations ( 17 – 20 ).

unlisted_practices: Compare AI-supported patient communication against standard clinician explanation, automated reminders, and non-AI personalised summaries before adopting it.
Require external validation, calibration across populations, transparent confidence intervals, and clinician verification before any AI-generated patient-facing risk projections are used clinically.
Clinicians should know how an AI model was trained, for which populations it was validated, when it should not be used, and who is accountable for wrong outputs.
Research reporting on AI should clearly describe the data used, external validation, model limitations, human oversight, and adverse effects.

screen.reason: This is a Perspective paper exploring the theoretical role and necessary governance/safeguards of AI in periodontal risk communication and recall adherence rather than an empirical study.
